title: Honeyed Turkish Chocolate Stuffed Grape Leaves
description: These sweet grape leaves are filled with dark chocolate ganache, lightly fried to a crispy finish, then glazed with honey for a malty, festive treat.
instructions: Rinse grape leaves under cold water to remove excess brine and pat dry.
In a saucepan, melt butter and add coconut milk, honey, lemon zest, cinnamon, and a pinch of salt, stirring until the sauce thickens slightly.
Fold chopped dark chocolate into the warm sauce until smooth, then cool to room temperature.
Place a spoonful of chocolate mixture onto the center of each grape leaf, roll tightly, sealing the edges with a toothpick.
Heat olive oil in a deep pan to 180°C and carefully deep-fry the stuffed leaves for 2-3 minutes until golden and crisp.
Remove leaves with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Drizzle the remaining honey over the warm grape leaves and squeeze fresh lemon juice for brightness.
Sprinkle chopped pistachios if desired, and serve immediately.
